the fractional order energy equations derived in Allagui and Machado (2016) can be applied to any supercapacitor device.
the fractional order energy stored in supercapacitor can be computed using a fractional order energy differential equation.
the energy stored in carbon carbon supercapcapacitors can be quantified using a fractional order energy differential equation and that the energy stored is dependent on the charging rate.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a mathematical model that describes the behavior of supercapacitors and that can be used to determine the amount of energy that is stored in them.
the development of a fractional calculus based energy equation to quantify the energy stored in supercapacitor devices.
the energy stored in supercapacitor devices when they are charged by a linear ramp.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the amount of energy that can be stored in a super capacitor is proportional to its capacitance in proper Farad units.
the energy stored in supercapacitor can be determined using a fractional order energy differential equation.
the fractional order energy model is the correct model to use in supercapacitor analysis.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the fractional order energy equations derived in Allagui and Al-Muhtadi (2015) and Allagui et. al. (2015, 2016) are valid in a wide range of charging conditions.
the energy stored in supercapacitor is not a constant but depends on the charging method and the amount of energy supplied to the device.
the fractional order energy is a useful tool for the analysis of supercapacitors under linear voltage ramps.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the energy stored in these devices is much less than what is stored in a regular capacitor.
the amount of energy that can be stored in a super capacitor is not a function of the voltage applied but rather a function of the charging rate.
the energy stored in supercapacitor devices is not quantifiable by the classical energy equation.
